One Measure as a Wide Table

Source: R/wide_table.R
wide_table.Rd

Turn one column of a daily table into a wide table: stations, houses or pigs in rows, days (or hours) in columns, plus the total or mean over the window.

wide_table(x, value)

Arguments

x

A table from monitor_stations(), monitor_houses(), monitor_pigs() or monitor_hours() (also as part of run_monitor()).

value

Name of the column to show, e.g. "feed_kg".

Value

A data.table: the ID columns (location, house, or location and responder), one column per day ("MM-DD", or "YYYY-MM-DD" when the window spans the same day of two years) or per hour, and total for counts, kg and time, mean otherwise.

Examples

mon <- run_monitor(tidypptsda::nedap, verbose = 0)
wide_table(mon$stations, "n_visits")
#> Key: <location>
#>    location 05-19 05-20 05-21 05-22 05-23 05-24 05-25 total
#>      <char> <int> <int> <int> <int> <int> <int> <int> <num>
#> 1:      101   192   201   228   214   234   154   204  1427
#> 2:      102   163   167   216   238   158   118   162  1222
wide_table(mon$pigs, "feed_kg")
